title: Step 4a - Formatting Single Observation Input for Logistic Regression Predict

cues.en: Instructor: All right, my friends I hope you did amazing with that new exercise which was to predict the purchase decision of a new customer in the test set
cues.zh: 各位，希望你順利完成練習，預測測試集新顧客的購買決策，

cues.en: that was the first customer who is actually 30 years old and earns an estimated salary of 87,000 dollars, right?
cues.zh: 也就是第一位 30 歲、估計薪資 87,000 美元的顧客。

cues.en: If we have a look at our test set, you know the original test set before the scaling, this one.
cues.zh: 看縮放前的原始測試集，就是這個。

cues.en: This is exactly the customer you had to input in your predict method in order to predict the purchase decision.
cues.zh: 這正是要輸入 predict、預測購買決策的顧客。

cues.en: Alright? And now in this tutorial we're gonna check two things that first you got the right implementation of the predict method and mostly the right input inside the predict method.
cues.zh: 本節檢查兩件事：是否正確使用 predict，尤其輸入是否正確。

cues.en: And secondly, we'll also check if the prediction is correct.
cues.zh: 第二，確認預測是否正確。

cues.en: And in order to do this, well we're gonna have a look at Y test The purchase decision of that first customer is exactly this one.
cues.zh: 看 y_test，第一位顧客的購買決策就在這裡。

cues.en: You know because Y test contains all the real results here, all the real purchase decision.
cues.zh: y_test 包含所有真實結果，也就是真實購買決策。

cues.en: And so we're gonna see if indeed our model was able to make a correct prediction by predicting zero for this first customer
cues.zh: 所以要看模型是否能正確預測，對第一位

cues.en: of age 30 and estimated salary 87 K.
cues.zh: 30 歲、薪資 87K 的顧客預測 0。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's proceed to the solution.
cues.zh: 實作解答。

cues.en: Here it is predicting a new result.
cues.zh: 在這裡，Predicting a New Result。

cues.en: I will leave the training, and there we go.
cues.zh: 保留訓練部分，現在開始。

cues.en: So let's create a new code sale and now what was the first step?
cues.zh: 新增程式碼儲存格，第一步是什麼？

cues.en: Well, of course, the first step was to take our classifier.
cues.zh: 當然，先使用 classifier。

cues.en: Because of course the predict method as any other method has to be called from the classifier object itself.
cues.zh: 因為 predict 和其他方法一樣，必須從 classifier 物件呼叫。

cues.en: So we take our classifier object and then from this object we're gonna call this predict method.
cues.zh: 所以用 classifier 物件呼叫 predict。

cues.en: By the way, let me show you this again.
cues.zh: 順便再介紹一次。

cues.en: You have all the predict method which are: predict log probability, which will return the log, you know, the loger function of the probability
cues.zh: 還有其他預測方法，例如 predict_log_proba，傳回機率的

cues.en: that your prediction is one.
cues.zh: 對數，

cues.en: You know that the purchase decision is one.
cues.zh: 也就是購買決策為 1 的機率對數。

cues.en: And you also have the predict proba method, which returns of course, directly the probability that the purchase decision is one.
cues.zh: 以及 predict_proba，直接傳回購買決策為 1 的機率。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So depending on whether you want to have directly the final prediction, zero or one, or the probability that the dependent variable is equal to one.
cues.zh: 看你想直接取得 0 或 1，還是應變數為 1 的機率，

cues.en: Well you have the choice between predict and predict proba.
cues.zh: 可以選 predict 或 predict_proba。

cues.en: Okay? So here we're gonna take predict because we directly want to get the prediction whether or not that first customer of the test set purchased yes or no, the suv.
cues.zh: 這裡要直接知道第一位顧客是否買 SUV，所以用 predict。

cues.en: So here we're gonna add some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 加上括號。

cues.en: And now, now I'm really interested if you got this right.
cues.zh: 現在很想知道你是否做對。

cues.en: What did you put inside the predict method in order to predict the purchase decision of that customer who is
cues.zh: 要預測這位顧客，

cues.en: 30 years old and earns an estimated salary of 87,000?
cues.zh: 30 歲、估計薪資 87,000，括號裡放什麼？

cues.en: All right, well, first of all, let's remind the essential.
cues.zh: 先提醒重點。

cues.en: Any single observation inside the predict method has to be input in a double pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: predict 中的單筆觀測，必須放進雙層中括號。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: That's because the predict method expects from its input a two dimensional array.
cues.zh: 因為 predict 預期二維陣列。

cues.en: And how do we create a two dimensional array with only one observation?
cues.zh: 只有一筆觀測，如何建立二維陣列？

cues.en: You know, meaning only one row?
cues.zh: 也就是只有一列？

cues.en: Because what we're about input is a two dimensional matrix of one row and two columns where the row corresponds indeed to that single customer
cues.zh: 我們要輸入一列兩欄的二維矩陣，一列對應單一顧客，

cues.en: and columns correspond, in fact to the features, the age in the first column, and salary in the second column.
cues.zh: 欄位對應特徵，第一欄年齡，第二欄薪資。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Now I've told you everything.
cues.zh: 現在已說清楚。

cues.en: What you have to input here inside this second pair of square brackets which corresponds to the columns.
cues.zh: 第二層中括號對應各欄，裡面

cues.en: Well, you had to input the two values of these two features, the age and the salary.
cues.zh: 要填兩個特徵值，年齡與薪資。

cues.en: And therefore, since our first customer 30 years old, and earns an estimated salary of $87,000.
cues.zh: 第一位顧客 30 歲，估計薪資 87,000 美元，

cues.en: Well the two features here that we had to input in these, therefore two columns here is first 30 and then $87,000.
cues.zh: 所以兩欄先放 30，再放 87000。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that's the first thing you must absolutely do.
cues.zh: 這是絕對要做的第一件事。

cues.en: You know that you must absolutely have the right reflex, okay?
cues.zh: 必須養成正確習慣。

cues.en: Input your single observation within a double pair of square brackets to give the expected format of the two dimensional array
cues.zh: 單筆觀測放在雙層中括號，提供二維陣列格式

cues.en: to your predict method.
cues.zh: 給 predict。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So that was the first thing, but then not enough.
cues.zh: 但這還不夠。

cues.en: You had to do something else, which is?
cues.zh: 還需要做什麼？

cues.en: Of course, to scale that single observation, right?
cues.zh: 當然是縮放這筆觀測。

cues.en: Because 30 years old here and 87,000 dollars as the estimated salary are in the original scale, you know, before applying feature
cues.zh: 因為 30 歲與 87,000 美元仍在原始尺度，也就是還沒做

cues.en: scaling standardization.
cues.zh: 標準化縮放。

cues.en: And since our model was actually trained as we can see on X train and Y train, which were just previously feature scaled,
cues.zh: 模型訓練使用 X_train、y_train，其中特徵先前已縮放，

cues.en: you know, that's the result of feature scaling.
cues.zh: 這就是縮放後的結果。

cues.en: Well as I told you the predict methods can only be applied to observations where the features have the exact same scale as the one
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，predict 只能用在特徵尺度與

cues.en: that was used for the training.
cues.zh: 訓練時相同的觀測。

cues.en: And therefore here we need to apply the transform method in order to give our predict method, not only the right format here, but also the right scale.
cues.zh: 所以要使用 transform，不只提供正確格式，也要提供正確尺度。

cues.en: And that's why we have to transform this single observation input in the right format into that new scale.
cues.zh: 將這筆格式正確的觀測，轉成新的尺度。

cues.en: And so what we have to do here is take our SC object.
cues.zh: 因此使用 sc 物件。

cues.en: Remember that was the name of the feature scaling object which we used to apply feature scaling on both the matrix of features of the training set X train and the matrix of features of the tested X test.
cues.zh: 記得，它就是用來縮放訓練特徵矩陣 X_train 與測試特徵矩陣 X_test 的物件。

cues.en: So SC, and then remember, we call, there it is just below, the transform method.
cues.zh: 使用 sc，再呼叫下方的 transform。

cues.en: The transform method, which has to take as input this whole single prediction input in a 2D array.
cues.zh: 它接收整筆以二維陣列表示的觀測作為輸入。

cues.en: Aright and a second one, and perfect.
cues.zh: 加上第二個括號，很好。
